note: The coordination file for parallel work, and nothing else. When more than one session may write at once, the integrator fills lanes with one row per lane, each naming its session, its host and the paths it owns, and commits this file before any lane is dispatched. Lanes are given claims and never take or change one, which is what stops two writers landing on one file and the second silently dropping the first. The v2.1 build's thirteen lanes finished on 2026-08-11 and their claims are released, so the list is empty and no lane holds anything. An empty list is the release, not a lock: require_claim reads it as no claim model in force, so a solo session writes freely, which is what ADR-0008 means by a single writer being implicitly claimed. Fill it again before the next parallel run.
